about: A chip of BN5's whose code moved into BN6's engine (issue #82's C3): BN5's CanladEX held paralysed (hold: each game's own status step, the same bits in both) at (5,2), MegaMan with a folder of one HolyDrem H and 29 Cannon A in both games, the HolyDrem dealt first (a Giga chip: a folder of them alone never deals), BN5's chip 307 by BN5's own code and the registry's 314 by the same code moved (BN5's support routine 0x23 as BN6's 0x4D: its object, the fourth kind's 0x59, its double of MegaMan, the first kind's 0x1C, drawn from MegaMan's own sprite in each game, tools/xchiprecipe.py's MEGAMAN_LOADS, its shots, the third kind's 0x83, from BN5's point 0x1D of his, UNIT_STUBS, his palette BN6's own, tools/bn5_twins.py's audit of 0x0800DD8C), the first Custom screen's chip picked and OK, used at t30: every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it (docs/multirom/chips-code.md). Its dark gate (+0x15 1, usable while not dark) lets it out in both, MegaMan calm.
